entities.summary: "Soon We'll Be Found" is a song by Australian singer-songwriter Sia. Released on 13 October 2008, "Soon We'll Be Found" is Sia's third single from her fourth studio album, Some People Have Real Problems (2008). The single is only available for download in the UK, but the music video for "Soon We'll Be Found", in which Sia signs the lyrics in American Sign Language, was featured on the United States iTunes Store main page when it became the free music download of the week of 4 November 2008. Sia performed the song on Later...
